mobbin:f693c13b-9f45-4762-a988-c8e65b456.summary: From empty Workflows, the user builds a 'Pre-call Disclaimer' workflow, attaches it to event types, adds emails, and saves it.
steps: Workflows empty: Create and reminder template cards
New workflow for personal or team
Editor: Apply to all checkbox; 24h before; email attendees
Event type multi-select open (Team Quick Chat and others)
2 event types selected in the list
Offset 60 mins; Apply to all still available
Add action pop-up: Send email to host
Action 3: Send email to host plus Include calendar event
Saved: short message that Pre-call Disclaimer workflow updated
List: Pre-call Disclaimer; Active on 1 event type
steal: A multiple-choice list asks 'Which event type will this apply to?', next to 'Apply to all, including future event types' (screens 3-7).
The rule reads top to bottom: when it runs (before the start, plus an offset), then 'Do this' action cards (screens 3-8).
Placeholders such as {EVENT_NAME} and {ATTENDEE} fill in the email subject and text (screens 8, 10).
The list card shows what triggers the workflow and says 'Active on N event type' (screen 12).
avoid: Across 12 screens it only offers reminders by email or text message, with none of the auto-record or announcement actions Essentials needs per phase.
mobbin:f693c13b-9f45-4762-a988-c8e65b456.fit: Scenario manager: the best match for automation per scenario. A reusable When/Do rule set is attached to chosen event types, like SCE templates, and covers today's prep-email and auto-record defaults.
